## [1.0.4](https://github.com/ryykitty/twitch-patched/compare/v1.0.3...v1.0.4) (2026-10-04)

### Bug Fixes

* display Twitch 31.4.2 in the community directory ([bc6dd9f](https://github.com/ryykitty/twitch-patched/commit/bc6dd9f64c5964c1ee9c7373a836cc339bcc353a))
* select and enable ad blockers by default ([b371d8b](https://github.com/ryykitty/twitch-patched/commit/b371d8bf85ff518e6d52ae7458de7b05235829df))

patches.name: Auto-claim bonus channel points
patches.description: Claims available bonus rewards in live playback.

patches.name: Block client-requested ads
patches.description: Suppresses native ad requests. Restart Twitch after changing the setting.

patches.name: Block stream ads
patches.description: Replaces detected live-stream ads with direct Twitch playback from alternate player contexts. Prefers matching video quality. No external stream proxy.

patches.name: BTTV and 7TV emotes
patches.description: Renders global and channel emotes in chat with provider previews on tap.

patches.name: Hide feed and display ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored feed cards and display ads using Twitch's no-ad responses.

patches.name: Hide subscription discount banners
patches.description: Hides subscription offers and promotional labels, while retaining normal subscription actions.

patches.name: Hide Turbo promotions
patches.description: Hides Turbo entries, upsells and purchase buttons.

patches.name: Inspect Twitch APK
patches.description: Reports package, version and DEX class count during patching. Does not change the app.

patches.name: Playback diagnostics
patches.description: Records playlist structure and playback frame counters. Disabled by default.

patches.name: Reload stream
patches.description: Adds a reload button in live-player controls. Double-tap to reload.
